source_record.description:
About Uplane

Companies waste billions on bad ads, mismatched landing pages, and poor budget allocation. Uplane fixes this by building the AI technology for the marketing agency of the future. Our software supports creative producers with static ad creation, video ad creation, landing page design, and much more. We are building the AI software for the next generation of AI-native content producers and need ambitious, creative landing page designers with strong taste who will use our AI engine to deliver high-converting landing pages for our customers.

About The Role

We're seeking a highly motivated, English-speaking AI-native Landing Page Designer with experience in designing landing pages for performance marketing campaigns to join our team full-time (in San Francisco or Berlin on-site, hybrid or remote). In this role, you will work with our self-developed AI landing page engine to create and deliver conversion-optimised landing pages for the paid social campaigns of our clients. Your pages will be the destination for millions of clicks across Meta, Google, LinkedIn and TikTok.

Why Join

  • Uplane is the best place to learn how to design landing pages with AI. This is the skill every creative lead will need. Learn how to do it today, not in three years.

  • AI does the grunt work, you do the creative work. Our engine handles the tedious stuff so your time goes into concept, taste and design.

  • Millions of people will see your landing pages.

  • Take ownership and grow quickly.

  • Join a fast-growing, VC-backed company.

  • Culture: fast-moving, ambitious, fun, humble.

Responsibilities

  • AI Landing Page Design: You use our powerful, self-developed AI landing page engine to create and design stunning landing pages that will be seen by millions of people. You are in charge, the AI helps you fulfill your mission.

  • Team Collaboration: Work with an ambitious team of marketing managers and creative designers to ensure projects are executed to a high standard and in a timely manner.

  • Shape the AI engine: Give feedback to our product and engineering team and shape how our landing page engine will evolve and improve over time.

Requirements

  • Passion for designing landing pages, you love design and creative work

  • Years of experience in creating / designing landing pages

  • Work experience in paid social or with performance marketing campaigns

  • Fast learner, hard-working, and stress-resistant

  • Curious and excited about AI rather than afraid of it

  • Fluent English

Nice to Have

  • Work experience at a marketing agency

  • Experience with A/B testing and conversion rate optimisation

  • You have won awards for your creative work

  • You worked with big brands before
